title: Telegram Android Queries
sourceNote: Betafunktion. Telegrams databas på Android, läst ur appens datamapp data/data/org.telegram.messenger/files (data/user/0 är samma mapp). Den är inte krypterad där. Tiderna är unixsekunder och visas här med datetime(…, 'unixepoch', 'localtime'). Texten och avsändaren står i en blob i Telegrams eget format och läses med vanlig SQL för den version som är kontrollerad. Tabeller, kolumner och tider är kontrollerade mot en labbtelefon (Samsung med Android 16, Telegram med versionskod 73031, 2026-11-11). Strukturen kan skilja sig mellan Telegram-versioner, så kontrollera alltid mot databasen. Fler konton i samma app ligger i files/account1 och så vidare och letas inte upp; de kan öppnas som enskilda databaser.

paramLabels.idHex: Bildens id ur filnamnet som 16 hexadecimala tecken (åtta byte, lägst först)

databases.label: Android — cache4.db (Telegram)
databases.blurb: Meddelanden med tid, riktning, chatt, avsändare och text, chattarna med vad som är läst, och användarna. Texten läses ur meddelandets blob.
databases.dbPathHint: /data/data/org.telegram.messenger/files/cache4.db (+ -wal). Fler konton: files/account1/cache4.db och så vidare.
databases.source: Kontrollerad mot en labbtelefon (Samsung med Android 16, Telegram med versionskod 73031, 2026-11-11), där sex meddelanden jämfördes med stegen i en loggad laboration. messages_v2 har en rad per meddelande: date är meddelandets tid i hela unixsekunder, out är 1 för skickade, uid är chatten (positivt för en person, negativt för en grupp) och mid meddelandets id. Texten har ingen egen kolumn. Den står i blobben data, i Telegrams eget format, och queryerna läser den med vanlig SQL: de letar upp meddelandets tid i blobben och tar strängen som följer direkt efter. Det görs bara när blobben börjar med konstruktorn 0x7600b9d3 (D3B90076 i filen), som var den som labbtelefonens fem vanliga meddelanden hade; där stämde texten för alla fem. Andra Telegram-versioner har andra konstruktorer: då visas ingen text, och typen säger okänd konstruktor. Tjänstemeddelanden (0x7a800e0a i labbet, när gruppen skapades) har ingen text. Avsändaren läses också ur blobben, när den står där som en användare (0x59511722); annars är avsändaren chattens motpart. read_state: i labbet hade meddelandena i den lästa chatten 3 och de skickade i gruppen 2, där outbox_max i dialogs var 0. Att värdet 1 i read_state betyder läst (av mottagaren för ett skickat meddelande, på den här telefonen för ett mottaget) är tolkningen av det. send_state var 0 för alla; 1 skickas och 2 misslyckades är vanliga tolkningar som inte är kontrollerade. Medietypen kommer ur media_v4: 0 hade labbets mottagna bild; 1 fil, 2 röst- eller videomeddelande, 4 musik och 5 gif är Telegrams egna typer och inte kontrollerade. Ett meddelande utan rad i media_v4 och utan text (till exempel ett klistermärke, en plats eller ett kontaktkort) får typen annat innehåll utan text. Kolumnen media i messages_v2 var -1 för labbets textmeddelanden och 0 för bilden; den används inte för typen. Vilken fil som hör till meddelandet står i blobben. Chattar läser den inte och visar att meddelandet har media men inte filen. Härkomst läser den för en bild: labbets mottagna bild låg under Android/data/org.telegram.messenger/files/Telegram/Telegram Images/ med namnet -<id>_<nummer>.jpg, där id:t är bildens id i blobben (åtta byte efter konstruktorn 0xfb197a65) och numret är teckenkoden för en av bildens storlekar (121 är y), och storlekens antal byte i blobben var filens storlek. Skickade bilder, videor och filer är inte kontrollerade. Namnen i kolumnen name i users och chats är sparade i gemener för Telegrams sökning (namn;;;användarnamn). Namnet som det skrivs står i blobben data och läses därifrån för konstruktorerna 0xb1b8cc83 (users) och 0x41cbf256 (chats), som labbtelefonens två användare och enda grupp hade, och bara när det är lika långt som namnet i gemener; annars visas namnet i gemener. Queryn Användare och kontakter visar båda. Tiderna för labbets sex meddelanden var på sekunden desamma som i den andra telefonens Telegram-databas. Hemliga chattar, kanaler, vidarebefordrade meddelanden, svar och raderade meddelanden fanns inte i labbet. Databasen hade en -wal bredvid sig; de sex tabellerna hade lika många rader med och utan den.

queries.title: Meddelanden i tidsspann
queries.subtitle: Visar meddelandena i tidsspannet: tid, riktning, typ, chatt, avsändare, text och om meddelandet är läst.
queries.returns: tid, riktning, typ, chatt, från, text, läst, sändning, id, chattens id, UTC
queries.sql:
WITH h AS (
  SELECT m.mid, m.uid, m.date, m.out, m.read_state, m.send_state, m.media, m.ttl, m.data,
    hex(substr(m.data, 1, 512)) AS hx,
    printf('%02X%02X%02X%02X', m.date & 255, (m.date >> 8) & 255, (m.date >> 16) & 255, (m.date >> 24) & 255) AS dhex
  FROM messages_v2 m
  WHERE m.date BETWEEN {{unixStart}} AND {{unixEnd}}
), p AS (
  SELECT h.*, substr(hx, 1, 8) AS ctor,
    CASE WHEN substr(hx, 1, 8) = 'D3B90076' THEN instr(substr(hx, 33), dhex) ELSE 0 END AS q,
    CASE WHEN substr(hx, 12, 1) IN ('1', '3', '5', '7', '9', 'B', 'D', 'F') THEN CASE substr(hx, 1, 8) WHEN 'D3B90076' THEN 33 WHEN '0A0E807A' THEN 25 END END AS f
  FROM h
), t AS (
  SELECT p.*,
    CASE WHEN q > 0 AND (q - 1) % 8 = 0 THEN ((instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hx, q + 40, 1)) - 1) * 16 + instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hx, q + 40 + 1, 1)) - 1) END AS n,
    CASE WHEN f IS NOT NULL AND substr(hx, f, 8) = '22175159' THEN ((instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hx, f + 8 + 0, 1)) - 1) * 16 + instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hx, f + 8 + 0 + 1, 1)) - 1) + ((instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hx, f + 8 + 2, 1)) - 1) * 16 + instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hx, f + 8 + 2 + 1, 1)) - 1) * 256 + ((instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hx, f + 8 + 4, 1)) - 1) * 16 + instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hx, f + 8 + 4 + 1, 1)) - 1) * 65536 + ((instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hx, f + 8 + 6, 1)) - 1) * 16 + instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hx, f + 8 + 6 + 1, 1)) - 1) * 16777216 + ((instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hx, f + 8 + 8, 1)) - 1) * 16 + instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hx, f + 8 + 8 + 1, 1)) - 1) * 4294967296 + ((instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hx, f + 8 + 10, 1)) - 1) * 16 + instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hx, f + 8 + 10 + 1, 1)) - 1) * 1099511627776 + ((instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hx, f + 8 + 12, 1)) - 1) * 16 + instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hx, f + 8 + 12 + 1, 1)) - 1) * 281474976710656 END AS from_uid
  FROM p
), ua AS (
  SELECT u.uid, u.name AS sokrad, u.data, CASE WHEN hex(substr(u.data, 1, 4)) = '83CCB8B1' THEN ((instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(substr(u.data, 5, 1)), 1, 1)) - 1) * 16 + instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(substr(u.data, 5, 1)), 2, 1)) - 1) END AS fl
  FROM users u
), ub AS (
  SELECT ua.*, 21 + 8 * (fl & 1) AS p1, CASE WHEN fl & 2 THEN ((instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(substr(data, 21 + 8 * (fl & 1), 1)), 1, 1)) - 1) * 16 + instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(substr(data, 21 + 8 * (fl & 1), 1)), 2, 1)) - 1) END AS n1 FROM ua
), uc AS (
  SELECT ub.*, CASE WHEN (fl & 2) = 0 THEN p1 WHEN n1 < 254 THEN p1 + (n1 + 4) / 4 * 4 END AS p2 FROM ub
), ud AS (
  SELECT uc.*, CASE WHEN fl & 4 THEN ((instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(substr(data, p2, 1)), 1, 1)) - 1) * 16 + instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(substr(data, p2, 1)), 2, 1)) - 1) END AS n2 FROM uc
), ue AS (
  SELECT uid, CASE WHEN instr(sokrad, ';;;') > 0 THEN substr(sokrad, 1, instr(sokrad, ';;;') - 1) ELSE sokrad END AS sokt, CASE WHEN instr(sokrad, ';;;') > 0 THEN NULLIF(substr(sokrad, instr(sokrad, ';;;') + 3), '') END AS username,
    trim(COALESCE(CASE WHEN n1 < 254 THEN CAST(substr(data, p1 + 1, n1) AS TEXT) END, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(CASE WHEN n2 < 254 THEN CAST(substr(data, p2 + 1, n2) AS TEXT) END, '')) AS skrivet
  FROM ud
), un AS (
  SELECT uid, username, sokt, CASE WHEN skrivet <> '' AND length(skrivet) = length(sokt) THEN skrivet ELSE sokt END AS name FROM ue
), cn AS (
  SELECT c.uid, c.name AS sokt,
    CASE WHEN hex(substr(c.data, 1, 4)) = '56F2CB41' AND ((instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(substr(c.data, 17, 1)), 1, 1)) - 1) * 16 + instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(substr(c.data, 17, 1)), 2, 1)) - 1) < 254 AND length(CAST(substr(c.data, 18, ((instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(substr(c.data, 17, 1)), 1, 1)) - 1) * 16 + instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(substr(c.data, 17, 1)), 2, 1)) - 1)) AS TEXT)) = length(c.name)
      THEN CAST(substr(c.data, 18, ((instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(substr(c.data, 17, 1)), 1, 1)) - 1) * 16 + instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(substr(c.data, 17, 1)), 2, 1)) - 1)) AS TEXT) ELSE c.name END AS name
  FROM chats c
)
SELECT
  datetime(t.date, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS tid_lokal,
  CASE WHEN t.ctor = '0A0E807A' THEN 'tjänst' WHEN t.out = 1 THEN 'skickat' ELSE 'mottaget' END AS riktning,
  CASE WHEN t.ctor = '0A0E807A' THEN 'tjänstemeddelande' WHEN t.ctor <> 'D3B90076' THEN 'okänd konstruktor ' || t.ctor WHEN t.n IS NULL THEN 'texten kunde inte läsas'
    ELSE CASE COALESCE((SELECT min(mv.type) FROM media_v4 mv WHERE mv.mid = t.mid AND mv.uid = t.uid AND mv.type <> 3), CASE WHEN t.n > 0 THEN -1 ELSE -2 END) WHEN 0 THEN 'bild eller video' WHEN 1 THEN 'fil' WHEN 2 THEN 'röst- eller videomeddelande'
      WHEN 4 THEN 'musik' WHEN 5 THEN 'gif' WHEN -1 THEN 'text' ELSE 'annat innehåll utan text' END END AS typ,
  CASE WHEN t.uid >= 4611686018427387904 THEN 'hemlig chatt ' || (t.uid & 4294967295) WHEN t.uid > 0 THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(cu.name, ''), 'användare ' || t.uid)
    ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(cc.name, ''), 'chatt ' || -t.uid) END AS chatt,
  CASE WHEN t.out = 1 THEN 'den här telefonen' ELSE CASE WHEN t.out = 1 THEN NULL WHEN t.from_uid IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(fu.name, ''), 'användare ' || t.from_uid)
    WHEN t.uid > 0 AND t.uid < 4611686018427387904 THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(cu.name, ''), 'användare ' || t.uid) END END AS fran,
  NULLIF(CASE WHEN t.n < 254 THEN CAST(substr(t.data, 16 + (t.q - 1) / 2 + 6, t.n) AS TEXT)
    WHEN t.n = 254 THEN CAST(substr(t.data, 16 + (t.q - 1) / 2 + 9, ((instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(t.hx, t.q + 42, 1)) - 1) * 16 + instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(t.hx, t.q + 42 + 1, 1)) - 1) + ((instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(t.hx, t.q + 44, 1)) - 1) * 16 + instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(t.hx, t.q + 44 + 1, 1)) - 1) * 256 + ((instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(t.hx, t.q + 46, 1)) - 1) * 16 + instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(t.hx, t.q + 46 + 1, 1)) - 1) * 65536) AS TEXT) END, '') AS text,
  CASE WHEN t.read_state & 1 THEN 'ja' ELSE 'nej' END AS last,
  CASE t.send_state WHEN 0 THEN 'skickat' WHEN 1 THEN 'skickas' WHEN 2 THEN 'misslyckades' ELSE 'värde ' || t.send_state END AS sandning,
  t.mid AS meddelande_id,
  CAST(t.uid AS TEXT) AS chatt_id,
  datetime(t.date, 'unixepoch') AS tid_utc
FROM t
LEFT JOIN un cu ON cu.uid = t.uid
LEFT JOIN cn cc ON cc.uid = -t.uid
LEFT JOIN un fu ON fu.uid = t.from_uid
ORDER BY t.date, t.mid;

queries.title: Meddelanden med media
queries.subtitle: Meddelandena som Telegram har registrerat som media (media_v4), med typ, tid, riktning och chatt.
queries.returns: tid, riktning, chatt, typ, blobbens storlek, id, chattens id, UTC
queries.sql:
WITH ua AS (
  SELECT u.uid, u.name AS sokrad, u.data, CASE WHEN hex(substr(u.data, 1, 4)) = '83CCB8B1' THEN ((instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(substr(u.data, 5, 1)), 1, 1)) - 1) * 16 + instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(substr(u.data, 5, 1)), 2, 1)) - 1) END AS fl
  FROM users u
), ub AS (
  SELECT ua.*, 21 + 8 * (fl & 1) AS p1, CASE WHEN fl & 2 THEN ((instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(substr(data, 21 + 8 * (fl & 1), 1)), 1, 1)) - 1) * 16 + instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(substr(data, 21 + 8 * (fl & 1), 1)), 2, 1)) - 1) END AS n1 FROM ua
), uc AS (
  SELECT ub.*, CASE WHEN (fl & 2) = 0 THEN p1 WHEN n1 < 254 THEN p1 + (n1 + 4) / 4 * 4 END AS p2 FROM ub
), ud AS (
  SELECT uc.*, CASE WHEN fl & 4 THEN ((instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(substr(data, p2, 1)), 1, 1)) - 1) * 16 + instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(substr(data, p2, 1)), 2, 1)) - 1) END AS n2 FROM uc
), ue AS (
  SELECT uid, CASE WHEN instr(sokrad, ';;;') > 0 THEN substr(sokrad, 1, instr(sokrad, ';;;') - 1) ELSE sokrad END AS sokt, CASE WHEN instr(sokrad, ';;;') > 0 THEN NULLIF(substr(sokrad, instr(sokrad, ';;;') + 3), '') END AS username,
    trim(COALESCE(CASE WHEN n1 < 254 THEN CAST(substr(data, p1 + 1, n1) AS TEXT) END, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(CASE WHEN n2 < 254 THEN CAST(substr(data, p2 + 1, n2) AS TEXT) END, '')) AS skrivet
  FROM ud
), un AS (
  SELECT uid, username, sokt, CASE WHEN skrivet <> '' AND length(skrivet) = length(sokt) THEN skrivet ELSE sokt END AS name FROM ue
), cn AS (
  SELECT c.uid, c.name AS sokt,
    CASE WHEN hex(substr(c.data, 1, 4)) = '56F2CB41' AND ((instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(substr(c.data, 17, 1)), 1, 1)) - 1) * 16 + instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(substr(c.data, 17, 1)), 2, 1)) - 1) < 254 AND length(CAST(substr(c.data, 18, ((instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(substr(c.data, 17, 1)), 1, 1)) - 1) * 16 + instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(substr(c.data, 17, 1)), 2, 1)) - 1)) AS TEXT)) = length(c.name)
      THEN CAST(substr(c.data, 18, ((instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(substr(c.data, 17, 1)), 1, 1)) - 1) * 16 + instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(substr(c.data, 17, 1)), 2, 1)) - 1)) AS TEXT) ELSE c.name END AS name
  FROM chats c
)
SELECT
  datetime(m.date, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS tid_lokal,
  CASE WHEN m.out = 1 THEN 'skickat' ELSE 'mottaget' END AS riktning,
  CASE WHEN mv.uid >= 4611686018427387904 THEN 'hemlig chatt ' || (mv.uid & 4294967295) WHEN mv.uid > 0 THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(cu.name, ''), 'användare ' || mv.uid)
    ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(cc.name, ''), 'chatt ' || -mv.uid) END AS chatt,
  CASE mv.type WHEN 0 THEN 'bild eller video' WHEN 1 THEN 'fil' WHEN 2 THEN 'röst- eller videomeddelande' WHEN 3 THEN 'länk' WHEN 4 THEN 'musik' WHEN 5 THEN 'gif' ELSE 'typ ' || mv.type END AS typ,
  length(mv.data) AS blob_byte,
  mv.mid AS meddelande_id,
  CAST(mv.uid AS TEXT) AS chatt_id,
  datetime(m.date, 'unixepoch') AS tid_utc
FROM media_v4 mv
JOIN messages_v2 m ON m.mid = mv.mid AND m.uid = mv.uid
LEFT JOIN un cu ON cu.uid = mv.uid
LEFT JOIN cn cc ON cc.uid = -mv.uid
ORDER BY m.date, mv.mid, mv.type;

queries.title: Chattar
queries.subtitle: Chattarna i dialogs med namn, antal meddelanden, senaste tid, olästa och hur långt meddelandena är lästa åt båda håll.
queries.returns: slag, chatt, användarnamn, meddelanden, senaste, olästa, läst hit (mottagna och skickade), fäst, mapp, id, UTC
queries.sql:
WITH ua AS (
  SELECT u.uid, u.name AS sokrad, u.data, CASE WHEN hex(substr(u.data, 1, 4)) = '83CCB8B1' THEN ((instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(substr(u.data, 5, 1)), 1, 1)) - 1) * 16 + instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(substr(u.data, 5, 1)), 2, 1)) - 1) END AS fl
  FROM users u
), ub AS (
  SELECT ua.*, 21 + 8 * (fl & 1) AS p1, CASE WHEN fl & 2 THEN ((instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(substr(data, 21 + 8 * (fl & 1), 1)), 1, 1)) - 1) * 16 + instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(substr(data, 21 + 8 * (fl & 1), 1)), 2, 1)) - 1) END AS n1 FROM ua
), uc AS (
  SELECT ub.*, CASE WHEN (fl & 2) = 0 THEN p1 WHEN n1 < 254 THEN p1 + (n1 + 4) / 4 * 4 END AS p2 FROM ub
), ud AS (
  SELECT uc.*, CASE WHEN fl & 4 THEN ((instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(substr(data, p2, 1)), 1, 1)) - 1) * 16 + instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(substr(data, p2, 1)), 2, 1)) - 1) END AS n2 FROM uc
), ue AS (
  SELECT uid, CASE WHEN instr(sokrad, ';;;') > 0 THEN substr(sokrad, 1, instr(sokrad, ';;;') - 1) ELSE sokrad END AS sokt, CASE WHEN instr(sokrad, ';;;') > 0 THEN NULLIF(substr(sokrad, instr(sokrad, ';;;') + 3), '') END AS username,
    trim(COALESCE(CASE WHEN n1 < 254 THEN CAST(substr(data, p1 + 1, n1) AS TEXT) END, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(CASE WHEN n2 < 254 THEN CAST(substr(data, p2 + 1, n2) AS TEXT) END, '')) AS skrivet
  FROM ud
), un AS (
  SELECT uid, username, sokt, CASE WHEN skrivet <> '' AND length(skrivet) = length(sokt) THEN skrivet ELSE sokt END AS name FROM ue
), cn AS (
  SELECT c.uid, c.name AS sokt,
    CASE WHEN hex(substr(c.data, 1, 4)) = '56F2CB41' AND ((instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(substr(c.data, 17, 1)), 1, 1)) - 1) * 16 + instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(substr(c.data, 17, 1)), 2, 1)) - 1) < 254 AND length(CAST(substr(c.data, 18, ((instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(substr(c.data, 17, 1)), 1, 1)) - 1) * 16 + instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(substr(c.data, 17, 1)), 2, 1)) - 1)) AS TEXT)) = length(c.name)
      THEN CAST(substr(c.data, 18, ((instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(substr(c.data, 17, 1)), 1, 1)) - 1) * 16 + instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(substr(c.data, 17, 1)), 2, 1)) - 1)) AS TEXT) ELSE c.name END AS name
  FROM chats c
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN d.did >= 4611686018427387904 THEN 'hemlig chatt' WHEN d.did > 0 THEN 'person' ELSE 'grupp eller kanal' END AS slag,
  CASE WHEN d.did >= 4611686018427387904 THEN 'hemlig chatt ' || (d.did & 4294967295) WHEN d.did > 0 THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(cu.name, ''), 'användare ' || d.did)
    ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(cc.name, ''), 'chatt ' || -d.did) END AS chatt,
  cu.username AS anvandarnamn,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM messages_v2 m WHERE m.uid = d.did) AS meddelanden,
  datetime(d.date, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS senaste_lokal,
  d.unread_count AS olasta,
  d.inbox_max AS last_hit_mottagna,
  d.outbox_max AS last_hit_skickade,
  CASE WHEN d.pinned > 0 THEN 'ja' END AS fast,
  d.folder_id AS mapp,
  CAST(d.did AS TEXT) AS chatt_id,
  datetime(d.date, 'unixepoch') AS senaste_utc
FROM dialogs d
LEFT JOIN un cu ON cu.uid = d.did
LEFT JOIN cn cc ON cc.uid = -d.did
ORDER BY d.date DESC;

queries.title: Användare och kontakter
queries.subtitle: Användarna som Telegram har sparat, med namnet som det skrivs och som det sparats för sökning, om de står i kontakterna och den sparade statustiden.
queries.returns: namn, namn i sökningen, användarnamn, Telegram-id, i kontakterna, ömsesidig, har chatt, status, rått värde
queries.sql:

  SELECT u.uid, u.name AS sokrad, u.data, CASE WHEN hex(substr(u.data, 1, 4)) = '83CCB8B1' THEN ((instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(substr(u.data, 5, 1)), 1, 1)) - 1) * 16 + instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(substr(u.data, 5, 1)), 2, 1)) - 1) END AS fl
  FROM users u
), ub AS (
  SELECT ua.*, 21 + 8 * (fl & 1) AS p1, CASE WHEN fl & 2 THEN ((instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(substr(data, 21 + 8 * (fl & 1), 1)), 1, 1)) - 1) * 16 + instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(substr(data, 21 + 8 * (fl & 1), 1)), 2, 1)) - 1) END AS n1 FROM ua
), uc AS (
  SELECT ub.*, CASE WHEN (fl & 2) = 0 THEN p1 WHEN n1 < 254 THEN p1 + (n1 + 4) / 4 * 4 END AS p2 FROM ub
), ud AS (
  SELECT uc.*, CASE WHEN fl & 4 THEN ((instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(substr(data, p2, 1)), 1, 1)) - 1) * 16 + instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(substr(data, p2, 1)), 2, 1)) - 1) END AS n2 FROM uc
), ue AS (
  SELECT uid, CASE WHEN instr(sokrad, ';;;') > 0 THEN substr(sokrad, 1, instr(sokrad, ';;;') - 1) ELSE sokrad END AS sokt, CASE WHEN instr(sokrad, ';;;') > 0 THEN NULLIF(substr(sokrad, instr(sokrad, ';;;') + 3), '') END AS username,
    trim(COALESCE(CASE WHEN n1 < 254 THEN CAST(substr(data, p1 + 1, n1) AS TEXT) END, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(CASE WHEN n2 < 254 THEN CAST(substr(data, p2 + 1, n2) AS TEXT) END, '')) AS skrivet
  FROM ud
), un AS (
  SELECT uid, username, sokt, CASE WHEN skrivet <> '' AND length(skrivet) = length(sokt) THEN skrivet ELSE sokt END AS name FROM ue
), cn AS (
  SELECT c.uid, c.name AS sokt,
    CASE WHEN hex(substr(c.data, 1, 4)) = '56F2CB41' AND ((instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(substr(c.data, 17, 1)), 1, 1)) - 1) * 16 + instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(substr(c.data, 17, 1)), 2, 1)) - 1) < 254 AND length(CAST(substr(c.data, 18, ((instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(substr(c.data, 17, 1)), 1, 1)) - 1) * 16 + instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(substr(c.data, 17, 1)), 2, 1)) - 1)) AS TEXT)) = length(c.name)

  FROM chats c

SELECT
  n.name AS namn,
  n.sokt AS namn_i_sokningen,

  SELECT h.*, substr(hx, 1, 8) AS ctor,
    CASE WHEN substr(hx, 1, 8) = 'D3B90076' THEN instr(substr(hx, 33), dhex) ELSE 0 END AS q,
    CASE WHEN substr(hx, 12, 1) IN ('1', '3', '5', '7', '9', 'B', 'D', 'F') THEN CASE substr(hx, 1, 8) WHEN 'D3B90076' THEN 33 WHEN '0A0E807A' THEN 25 END END AS f
  FROM h

  SELECT p.*,
    CASE WHEN q > 0 AND (q - 1) % 8 = 0 THEN ((instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hx, q + 40, 1)) - 1) * 16 + instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hx, q + 40 + 1, 1)) - 1) END AS n,
    CASE WHEN f IS NOT NULL AND substr(hx, f, 8) = '22175159' THEN ((instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hx, f + 8 + 0, 1)) - 1) * 16 + instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hx, f + 8 + 0 + 1, 1)) - 1) + ((instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hx, f + 8 + 2, 1)) - 1) * 16 + instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hx, f + 8 + 2 + 1, 1)) - 1) * 256 + ((instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hx, f + 8 + 4, 1)) - 1) * 16 + instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hx, f + 8 + 4 + 1, 1)) - 1) * 65536 + ((instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hx, f + 8 + 6, 1)) - 1) * 16 + instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hx, f + 8 + 6 + 1, 1)) - 1) * 16777216 + ((instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hx, f + 8 + 8, 1)) - 1) * 16 + instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hx, f + 8 + 8 + 1, 1)) - 1) * 4294967296 + ((instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hx, f + 8 + 10, 1)) - 1) * 16 + instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hx, f + 8 + 10 + 1, 1)) - 1) * 1099511627776 + ((instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hx, f + 8 + 12, 1)) - 1) * 16 + instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hx, f + 8 + 12 + 1, 1)) - 1) * 281474976710656 END AS from_uid
  FROM p

    CASE WHEN f IS NOT NULL AND substr(hx, f, 8) = '22175159' THEN ((instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hx, f + 8 + 0, 1)) - 1) * 16 + instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hx, f + 8 + 0 + 1, 1)) - 1) + ((instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hx, f + 8 + 2, 1)) - 1) * 16 + instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hx, f + 8 + 2 + 1, 1)) - 1) * 256 + ((instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hx, f + 8 + 4, 1)) - 1) * 16 + instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hx, f + 8 + 4 + 1, 1)) - 1) * 65536 + ((instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hx, f + 8 + 6, 1)) - 1) * 16 + instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hx, f + 8 + 6 + 1, 1)) - 1) * 16777216 + ((instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hx, f + 8 + 8, 1)) - 1) * 16 + instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hx, f + 8 + 8 + 1, 1)) - 1) * 4294967296 + ((instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hx, f + 8 + 10, 1)) - 1) * 16 + instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hx, f + 8 + 10 + 1, 1)) - 1) * 1099511627776 + ((instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hx, f + 8 + 12, 1)) - 1) * 16 + instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hx, f + 8 + 12 + 1, 1)) - 1) * 281474976710656 END AS from_uid
  FROM p
), ua AS (
  SELECT u.uid, u.name AS sokrad, u.data, CASE WHEN hex(substr(u.data, 1, 4)) = '83CCB8B1' THEN ((instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(substr(u.data, 5, 1)), 1, 1)) - 1) * 16 + instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(substr(u.data, 5, 1)), 2, 1)) - 1) END AS fl
  FROM users u
), ub AS (
  SELECT ua.*, 21 + 8 * (fl & 1) AS p1, CASE WHEN fl & 2 THEN ((instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(substr(data, 21 + 8 * (fl & 1), 1)), 1, 1)) - 1) * 16 + instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(substr(data, 21 + 8 * (fl & 1), 1)), 2, 1)) - 1) END AS n1 FROM ua
), uc AS (
  SELECT ub.*, CASE WHEN (fl & 2) = 0 THEN p1 WHEN n1 < 254 THEN p1 + (n1 + 4) / 4 * 4 END AS p2 FROM ub
), ud AS (
  SELECT uc.*, CASE WHEN fl & 4 THEN ((instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(substr(data, p2, 1)), 1, 1)) - 1) * 16 + instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(substr(data, p2, 1)), 2, 1)) - 1) END AS n2 FROM uc
), ue AS (
  SELECT uid, CASE WHEN instr(sokrad, ';;;') > 0 THEN substr(sokrad, 1, instr(sokrad, ';;;') - 1) ELSE sokrad END AS sokt, CASE WHEN instr(sokrad, ';;;') > 0 THEN NULLIF(substr(sokrad, instr(sokrad, ';;;') + 3), '') END AS username,
    trim(COALESCE(CASE WHEN n1 < 254 THEN CAST(substr(data, p1 + 1, n1) AS TEXT) END, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(CASE WHEN n2 < 254 THEN CAST(substr(data, p2 + 1, n2) AS TEXT) END, '')) AS skrivet
  FROM ud
), un AS (
  SELECT uid, username, sokt, CASE WHEN skrivet <> '' AND length(skrivet) = length(sokt) THEN skrivet ELSE sokt END AS name FROM ue
), cn AS (
  SELECT c.uid, c.name AS sokt,
    CASE WHEN hex(substr(c.data, 1, 4)) = '56F2CB41' AND ((instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(substr(c.data, 17, 1)), 1, 1)) - 1) * 16 + instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(substr(c.data, 17, 1)), 2, 1)) - 1) < 254 AND length(CAST(substr(c.data, 18, ((instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(substr(c.data, 17, 1)), 1, 1)) - 1) * 16 + instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(substr(c.data, 17, 1)), 2, 1)) - 1)) AS TEXT)) = length(c.name)
      THEN CAST(substr(c.data, 18, ((instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(substr(c.data, 17, 1)), 1, 1)) - 1) * 16 + instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(substr(c.data, 17, 1)), 2, 1)) - 1)) AS TEXT) ELSE c.name END AS name
  FROM chats c
)
SELECT CAST(m.uid AS TEXT) AS thread_id, m.uid AS member_id,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(cu.name, ''), 'användare ' || m.uid) AS member_name,
  COALESCE('@' || cu.username, 'Telegram-id ' || m.uid) AS member_address,
  NULL AS member_note
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT uid FROM messages_v2 WHERE uid > 0 AND uid < 4611686018427387904) m
LEFT JOIN un cu ON cu.uid = m.uid
UNION ALL
SELECT CAST(g.uid AS TEXT), g.from_uid,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(fu.name, ''), 'användare ' || g.from_uid),
  COALESCE('@' || fu.username, 'Telegram-id ' || g.from_uid),
  'skrev i gruppen'
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT uid, from_uid FROM t WHERE from_uid IS NOT NULL) g
LEFT JOIN un fu ON fu.uid = g.from_uid
ORDER BY 1, 3;

queries.title: Chattar: meddelandena i en chatt
queries.description: Används av Chattar. Meddelandena i chatten med tid, riktning, avsändare, text och typ, lästa som i queryn Meddelanden i tidsspann. Texten läses bara för den kontrollerade konstruktorn.

times.label: Meddelandets tid

details.label: Läst (read_state, rått värde; 3 i den lästa chatten och 2 på olästa i labbet)
Kolumnen media (media_raw, rått värde; -1 för text och 0 för bilden i labbet)
Blobbens konstruktor (ctor, de fyra första byten)

queries.sql:
WITH h AS (
  SELECT m.mid, m.uid, m.date, m.out, m.read_state, m.send_state, m.media, m.ttl, m.data,
    hex(substr(m.data, 1, 512)) AS hx,
    printf('%02X%02X%02X%02X', m.date & 255, (m.date >> 8) & 255, (m.date >> 16) & 255, (m.date >> 24) & 255) AS dhex
  FROM messages_v2 m
  WHERE m.uid = '{{threadId}}'
), p AS (
  SELECT h.*, substr(hx, 1, 8) AS ctor,
    CASE WHEN substr(hx, 1, 8) = 'D3B90076' THEN instr(substr(hx, 33), dhex) ELSE 0 END AS q,
    CASE WHEN substr(hx, 12, 1) IN ('1', '3', '5', '7', '9', 'B', 'D', 'F') THEN CASE substr(hx, 1, 8) WHEN 'D3B90076' THEN 33 WHEN '0A0E807A' THEN 25 END END AS f
  FROM h
), t AS (
  SELECT p.*,
    CASE WHEN q > 0 AND (q - 1) % 8 = 0 THEN ((instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hx, q + 40, 1)) - 1) * 16 + instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hx, q + 40 + 1, 1)) - 1) END AS n,
    CASE WHEN f IS NOT NULL AND substr(hx, f, 8) = '22175159' THEN ((instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hx, f + 8 + 0, 1)) - 1) * 16 + instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hx, f + 8 + 0 + 1, 1)) - 1) + ((instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hx, f + 8 + 2, 1)) - 1) * 16 + instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hx, f + 8 + 2 + 1, 1)) - 1) * 256 + ((instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hx, f + 8 + 4, 1)) - 1) * 16 + instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hx, f + 8 + 4 + 1, 1)) - 1) * 65536 + ((instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hx, f + 8 + 6, 1)) - 1) * 16 + instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hx, f + 8 + 6 + 1, 1)) - 1) * 16777216 + ((instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hx, f + 8 + 8, 1)) - 1) * 16 + instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hx, f + 8 + 8 + 1, 1)) - 1) * 4294967296 + ((instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hx, f + 8 + 10, 1)) - 1) * 16 + instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hx, f + 8 + 10 + 1, 1)) - 1) * 1099511627776 + ((instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hx, f + 8 + 12, 1)) - 1) * 16 + instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hx, f + 8 + 12 + 1, 1)) - 1) * 281474976710656 END AS from_uid
  FROM p
), ua AS (
  SELECT u.uid, u.name AS sokrad, u.data, CASE WHEN hex(substr(u.data, 1, 4)) = '83CCB8B1' THEN ((instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(substr(u.data, 5, 1)), 1, 1)) - 1) * 16 + instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(substr(u.data, 5, 1)), 2, 1)) - 1) END AS fl
  FROM users u
), ub AS (
  SELECT ua.*, 21 + 8 * (fl & 1) AS p1, CASE WHEN fl & 2 THEN ((instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(substr(data, 21 + 8 * (fl & 1), 1)), 1, 1)) - 1) * 16 + instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(substr(data, 21 + 8 * (fl & 1), 1)), 2, 1)) - 1) END AS n1 FROM ua
), uc AS (
  SELECT ub.*, CASE WHEN (fl & 2) = 0 THEN p1 WHEN n1 < 254 THEN p1 + (n1 + 4) / 4 * 4 END AS p2 FROM ub
), ud AS (
  SELECT uc.*, CASE WHEN fl & 4 THEN ((instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(substr(data, p2, 1)), 1, 1)) - 1) * 16 + instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(substr(data, p2, 1)), 2, 1)) - 1) END AS n2 FROM uc
), ue AS (
  SELECT uid, CASE WHEN instr(sokrad, ';;;') > 0 THEN substr(sokrad, 1, instr(sokrad, ';;;') - 1) ELSE sokrad END AS sokt, CASE WHEN instr(sokrad, ';;;') > 0 THEN NULLIF(substr(sokrad, instr(sokrad, ';;;') + 3), '') END AS username,
    trim(COALESCE(CASE WHEN n1 < 254 THEN CAST(substr(data, p1 + 1, n1) AS TEXT) END, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(CASE WHEN n2 < 254 THEN CAST(substr(data, p2 + 1, n2) AS TEXT) END, '')) AS skrivet
  FROM ud
), un AS (
  SELECT uid, username, sokt, CASE WHEN skrivet <> '' AND length(skrivet) = length(sokt) THEN skrivet ELSE sokt END AS name FROM ue
), cn AS (
  SELECT c.uid, c.name AS sokt,
    CASE WHEN hex(substr(c.data, 1, 4)) = '56F2CB41' AND ((instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(substr(c.data, 17, 1)), 1, 1)) - 1) * 16 + instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(substr(c.data, 17, 1)), 2, 1)) - 1) < 254 AND length(CAST(substr(c.data, 18, ((instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(substr(c.data, 17, 1)), 1, 1)) - 1) * 16 + instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(substr(c.data, 17, 1)), 2, 1)) - 1)) AS TEXT)) = length(c.name)
      THEN CAST(substr(c.data, 18, ((instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(substr(c.data, 17, 1)), 1, 1)) - 1) * 16 + instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(hex(substr(c.data, 17, 1)), 2, 1)) - 1)) AS TEXT) ELSE c.name END AS name
  FROM chats c
)
SELECT
  t.mid AS message_id, CAST(t.uid AS TEXT) AS thread_id, t.out AS from_me,
  CASE WHEN t.out = 1 THEN NULL WHEN t.from_uid IS NOT NULL THEN t.from_uid WHEN t.uid > 0 AND t.uid < 4611686018427387904 THEN t.uid END AS sender_id,
  CASE WHEN t.out = 1 THEN NULL WHEN t.from_uid IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(fu.name, ''), 'användare ' || t.from_uid)
    WHEN t.uid > 0 AND t.uid < 4611686018427387904 THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(cu.name, ''), 'användare ' || t.uid) END AS sender_name,
  NULLIF(CASE WHEN t.n < 254 THEN CAST(substr(t.data, 16 + (t.q - 1) / 2 + 6, t.n) AS TEXT)
    WHEN t.n = 254 THEN CAST(substr(t.data, 16 + (t.q - 1) / 2 + 9, ((instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(t.hx, t.q + 42, 1)) - 1) * 16 + instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(t.hx, t.q + 42 + 1, 1)) - 1) + ((instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(t.hx, t.q + 44, 1)) - 1) * 16 + instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(t.hx, t.q + 44 + 1, 1)) - 1) * 256 + ((instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(t.hx, t.q + 46, 1)) - 1) * 16 + instr('0123456789ABCDEF', substr(t.hx, t.q + 46 + 1, 1)) - 1) * 65536) AS TEXT) END, '') AS body,
  CASE WHEN t.ctor = '0A0E807A' THEN 'system' WHEN t.ctor <> 'D3B90076' OR t.n IS NULL THEN 'other'
    ELSE CASE COALESCE((SELECT min(mv.type) FROM media_v4 mv WHERE mv.mid = t.mid AND mv.uid = t.uid AND mv.type <> 3), CASE WHEN t.n > 0 THEN -1 ELSE -2 END) WHEN 0 THEN 'file' WHEN 1 THEN 'file' WHEN 2 THEN 'voice'
      WHEN 4 THEN 'audio' WHEN 5 THEN 'gif' WHEN -1 THEN 'text' ELSE 'other' END END AS kind,
  CASE WHEN t.ctor = '0A0E807A' THEN 'tjänstemeddelande' WHEN t.ctor <> 'D3B90076' THEN 'okänd konstruktor ' || t.ctor WHEN t.n IS NULL THEN 'texten kunde inte läsas'
    ELSE CASE COALESCE((SELECT min(mv.type) FROM media_v4 mv WHERE mv.mid = t.mid AND mv.uid = t.uid AND mv.type <> 3), CASE WHEN t.n > 0 THEN -1 ELSE -2 END) WHEN 0 THEN 'bild eller video' WHEN 1 THEN 'fil' WHEN 2 THEN 'röst- eller videomeddelande'
      WHEN 4 THEN 'musik' WHEN 5 THEN 'gif' WHEN -1 THEN 'text' ELSE 'annat innehåll utan text' END END AS kind_label,
  t.date, t.read_state, t.send_state, t.media AS media_raw, t.ttl, t.ctor
FROM t
LEFT JOIN un cu ON cu.uid = t.uid
LEFT JOIN cn cc ON cc.uid = -t.uid
LEFT JOIN un fu ON fu.uid = t.from_uid
ORDER BY t.date, t.mid;

queries.title: Chattar: medierna i en chatt
queries.description: Används av Chattar. En rad per meddelande med media, utan sökväg: vilken fil som hör till meddelandet står i blobben och läses inte. Chattar visar då att meddelandet har media.
queries.sql:
SELECT
  m.mid AS message_id, NULL AS file_path,
  CASE (SELECT min(mv.type) FROM media_v4 mv WHERE mv.mid = m.mid AND mv.uid = m.uid AND mv.type <> 3) WHEN 0 THEN 'bild eller video' WHEN 1 THEN 'fil'
    WHEN 2 THEN 'röst- eller videomeddelande' WHEN 4 THEN 'musik' WHEN 5 THEN 'gif' ELSE 'annat media' END AS media_name
FROM messages_v2 m
WHERE m.uid = '{{threadId}}'
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_v4 mv WHERE mv.mid = m.mid AND mv.uid = m.uid AND mv.type <> 3)
ORDER BY m.date, m.mid;
